name: Internal Knowledge Base
description: Generate factual Q&A from internal documentation, manuals, and standard operating procedures.
system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant with expertise in the following domain. Answer questions based on the provided documentation.
instruction_templates:
What is described in the following passage?

{text}

Based on the following information, answer comprehensively:

{text}

Explain the following concept or process:

{text}

What are the main takeaways from this text?

{text}
